answer.summary: Three API tests failed: two AssetLinkApiTest cases got 404 instead of 200, and ThreatArsenalVersionApiTest errored with an unattributed tenant write on Inject. The log shows tenant-isolation test helper and write-attribution warnings (TenantIsolationTestHelper, FAILCLOSED, WRITEATTR) and several unrelated DataPack and NPE errors, which points to shared tenant or test-data state rather than the change. None of the three failing tests or the touched files (OpenCRQCounterpartProvider, XtmOneClient) is in the failure path. The log does not prove a race, so confidence is moderate.

evidence.quote: Caused by: java.lang.IllegalStateException: unattributed tenant write: Inject
